contract:
Coordinator's api.ts changes in 5f0b09e (verbatim new text):
 *   Created: on the player's move that leaves the question's attemptFen (a graded try, or a move from another position after the player moved on), and at the end of the game (finished, resigned or abandoned) for a question still open or shown. Never while its position is still on the board: until then its reveal and best move stay on the server (FR-8).
 *   Replaced: a new tutor ask (e.g. Hint after a player_blunder takeback) that replaces a question whose attemptFen is the current position does not release it. The server keeps it as a pending note (saved, not in GameView) and releases it, attempt null, by the same rules: the move that leaves that position, or the end of the game. A takeback past its position drops it.
 *   Takebacks: ... A question shown by "Show me" (TutorStatus.question with reveal set) also survives a takeback that lands exactly on its attemptFen, and becomes a note when that position is left; any other takeback drops it.
 *   Grading in flight: an acknowledged try whose grading has not finished is saved with the game and graded again after a restart (NFR-14), so its note is not lost. A note's bestMove is filled in if the engine's analysis arrives after the note was made.
 (SSE section) While the game stays in that bot-failed state (playing, botThinking false, the bot's turn), every later "state" (e.g. after a try is graded) is followed by the same "error" again (#53).
 (TutorStatus.question) A shown question stays here until the next player move, a takeback (except one landing on its attemptFen, #53), a new tutor ask or the end of the game (#47).
